branch: Stationary ordered bonded supersolid, angularly mobile at fixed wall, wound drive minus wound rest on the identical solid and baths.
direction: Outward axial momentum delivered through the bottom, top and side of one closed surface. Slit tractions use the outward normal of each of the two fluid domains.
support: The axial and lateral weights equal one across the entire outlet and terminal order band. Each weight falls to zero in the specified exterior cell or pair of nested cells. The drive-minus-rest crystalline stress on the outer shell is zero because the order correction vanishes there on the same displacement. The physical sealed duct side is traversed below the disk and its two tractions are measured separately.
constraints: One common material translation convects the reference profile, order pins, material and both sides of the sealed wall. The native energy derivative includes those geometric loads. The separate solid force at fixed Eulerian order and the four alternate assignments of an Eulerian slope at the prescribed rim describe different variations. They cannot be added again to that translation work as independent forces.
